ac4b34f7: Loop through all set of code values (separated by semicolons) in the 'DU' array. Set 'DG' to the position of the field-value delimiter (':') followed by the current value of X (what the user entered). If a code is found to execute for the user's input value, execute it (using 'DIC("S")'). If the code returns true, quit this iterative loop. This allows tailored code to be executed for certain user input values.

b2bb69df: If there is no value in the current node (DB) of the utilities file, write out the segment of the DU array that follows the field-value delimiter for the current value. Then set X to the value before that delimiter (the value the user entered).

089a09e3: If the field is numeric and the input value has more than 24 decimal places, clear the input value.
